capabilities: Import public D&D Beyond character sheets as statblock notes
Re-sync imported characters with D&D Beyond
Embed the original D&D Beyond sheet page in notes
Save character images to a configurable folder
extras: Fetches from an unofficial, undocumented D&D Beyond endpoint that could change without warning; the plugin is read-only and never writes back. Not made, endorsed or supported by Atlas VTT or Atlas Online. Recommends installing the 5e 2024 Character Sheet template from the Armarium.
problem: Obsidian has no way to fetch D&D Beyond character sheets, so TTRPG players must rebuild statblocks by hand for Atlas VTT.

relations.evidence: Import any public D&D Beyond character sheet into Obsidian as a ready to use statblock for Atlas VTT.
The plugin fetches from an unofficial internal endpoint
The importer makes use of this plugin to default to 'Reader' view

summary: Importer that pulls public D&D Beyond character sheets into Obsidian as Atlas VTT statblock notes.
